notes: Enemy had 1 healer; only 1 of us carried anti-heal — usually wants two vs a heal comp.
Their main damage was Revenant (13k physical); 1/5 of us itemized armor — that hurt.
Enemy ran 1/5 on or near their meta core — they were off-meta too, the win was there.

coaching.headline: Four favored lane reads gone in 16 minutes — every fight after minute 9 was lost inside their half, and Revenant walked out 9/0.
coaching.team: The reads were ours — carry, mid, jungle and support all favored — and the film shows a team that kept diving two-man into their Fangtooth pit anyway: 9.3, 9.9, 11.7, 13.7 and 14.9 were all losses in their territory with a winning lane flagged absent, and the file prices those deaths at both of their Fangtooths. Revenant's entire kit is winning the isolated duel and we fed him exactly that, with the film flagging three of us for no magic resist into their comp. The 6.3 fight — first blood plus a kill on Mourn — showed the winning version; it cashed into nothing and was never repeated.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The double loss at their Fangtooth at 9.3 and 9.9 — five deaths in under a minute, in their pit, without numbers — bought the 10-minute Fangtooth and started the slide that ended the game at 16.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 had the favored read against Revenant and lost it 0/4 — all four deaths to the one hero whose kit punishes being caught alone, with the falls at 9.9 and 13.7 each pricing a Fangtooth. Murdock's game against Revenant is trap, out-range and poke; the walks into their river handed him the 1v1s he wanted.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324's Riktor won the support read but played forward without the tank to back it — 8182 mitigated and 5 wards, finishing 0/4. Riktor's pull is a kill button when four teammates stand behind it; in this film they usually did not.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs actually showed the restraint the game needed — two deaths and a won jungle read — but the flag lands on the other side of that coin: alive and ahead while the 14.9 fight was lost in their half. Winning the jungle only matters if Khaimera arrives where the team is dying.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~1.5s of lockdown): Kwang Surge of the Heavens (knockup 0.5s), Mourn Abduct (pull), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Serath. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s), Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
ourKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
ourKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
ourKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

ourKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
ourKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
ourKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
ourKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
enemyKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
enemyKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

enemyKits.combo: Judgement tether → Surge knockup → Fury of the Heavens slow, recall the blade
enemyKits.winCondition: tether a target, knock up and brawl with energized basics
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he tethers and knocks up
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait his blade-recall mobility, then punish when it's placed

enemyKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
enemyKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down
